prompt:
Create ONE transparent Inkarnate worldmap stamp of Fethlinn — a coastal Gaelic clan fortress with an east-facing harbor.

Use the attached APPROVED ROUND GAELIC FARMHOUSE as the PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE. Match its playful simplicity, chunky rounded proportions, slightly wonky hand-drawn dark-brown outlines and restrained flat watercolor coloring as closely as possible. Other references define the subject or architecture only. Keep exactly this SMALL MAP SYMBOL level of detail even though the output canvas is larger. This is a tiny charming atlas doodle, drawn with a few confident pen strokes and simple watercolor fills.

Subject: Fethlinn, a solid coastal fortress of a minor Albic laird clan in a medieval Gaelic low-fantasy world. A compact irregular stone ring wall enclosing ONE broad stout three-storey Gaelic tower house with a few large crenellations and almost blank walls; an attached simple slate-blue-roofed hall, three low chunky round defensive towers, and one tiny service cottage. Heavy cream-gray masonry represented by flat color and very few marks. A small southern gate opens toward the existing narrow southern land neck. A modest working harbor is attached to the EAST coast: one small boathouse and quay, two short plain wooden landing piers extending right into the sheltered water channel, one tiny brown wooden sailboat with a single cream sail. Show the rank of a minor clan through a compact practical compound and few buildings. A small contained courtyard is permitted inside the walls. Muted slate-blue roofs, pale warm gray stone, brown doors and timber, a little ochre thatch. Keep every form broad, rounded and slightly wonky, as simple and playful as the approved farmhouse. Reduce the subject to a few large, clear, slightly irregular shapes. For buildings, favor cozy, chubby proportions, generous simple roofs, almost plain walls and very few doors or windows. Adapt the architecture to the requested motif while retaining the approved cartoonish drawing language. Use the same gently elevated three-quarter map angle as the approved reference. Only a handful of short material marks. Dark-brown outlines carry the design. Warm muted natural colors, gentle paper grain inside the colored shapes only. Two flat tonal values per material, very little shading.

Show ONLY the requested stamp and indispensable attached elements. No extra props or scenery. No individually rendered stones, planks, straw fibers or shingles. No intricate cracks, weathering spots, elaborate ornament, realistic surface rendering or 3D lighting. No extra detail invented to fill the large canvas. Prioritize the simple playful reference shapes above all else. Do not copy the farmhouse subject when another motif is requested.

Entire motif visible, comfortable transparent margin. TRUE transparent PNG alpha background; Alpha = 0 outside the motif and in open gaps. No ground patch, scenery, shadow, colored backdrop, paper rectangle, pin frame, text, white outline or halo.
